title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. title: PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving increasingly depends on scaling training demonstrations, yet data growth does not guarantee proportional gains. Existing curation methods typically infer data value from intrinsic sample properties or training-dependent proxies that do not measure downstream policy utility. title: Lang-SVG: Hierarchical Image Vectorization with Language Priors
summary: Image vectorization reconstructs raster images as compact scalable vector graph- ics (SVG), providing a structured and editable code representation of images. However, most existing vectorization methods optimize for pixel-level render- ing fidelity, often producing SVGs that lack alignment with human-perceived object-part hierarchies, making them difficult to manipulate.
